episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Desperate to raise a fortune, Park Hae-kang tries every scheme imaginable. But when he still comes up short, a tip leads him to an apartment complex.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After discovering the apartment's reserve fund, Hae-kang sets out to steal it. But first, he must somehow win the election to join the association.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hae-kang enters a tight and competitive election. While a nosy opponent tries to sway voters, he spots a unique opportunity to win over the residents.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After winning the election, Hae-kang aims for the presidency. But when his gangster past is exposed, a new subway entrance becomes his lifeline.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Having finally reached his goal, Hae-kang prepares to disappear without a trace. But when he heads to the bank to claim the cash, everything unravels.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With Jang Suk-jin on their tail, Hae-kang and Kang Ha-ri scramble to keep their secret safe. Soon, they launch a crusade to find the missing funds.
